title: Exec staff meeting prep notes - 2026-03-04
content:
Purpose: prep notes for Exec Staff sync (tight 60m) — align on Q1 priorities, Dedicated capacity rollout status, private deployment ask from FinServ pilot, and any escalations needing exec attention.

High-level agenda (60 min):
- 0-5m quick wins & headlines (brief: product launch success metrics, major incidents)
- 5-25m Product updates (hosted API performance, Dedicated rollout, private pilot)
- 25-40m Ops & reliability (SRE report, incident trends, capacity constraints)
- 40-55m GTM and customers (key renewals, FinServ pilot ask, pricing discussion)
- 55-60m Decisions & next steps (assign owners, confirm timelines)

Key headlines to surface:
- Hosted API latency: p50 stable, p95 improved by 12% after kernel selection change; but we saw 3 sustained p99 spikes last week tied to cold KV cache recomputations. Need SRE + serving-runtime mitigation plan.
- Dedicated: Beta customers (2) onboarded; throughput meeting expectations but tail latency for long-context loads (16k) is 30% above SLO. Engineering proposed staged quantization and model-sharding experiment.
- Private (FinServ pilot): legal signoffs pending 2 items (data handling SLA, KMS key escrow). Customer asks for on-prem availability in late April — need alignment on delivery risk.
- Cost optimization: Redwood Optimize A/B suggestion reduced tokens/sec cost by ~8% in test workload; propose pilot with 3 mid-size customers.

Questions for exec discussion / decisions needed:
1) Private pilot timeline: do we commit to late-Apr delivery window contingent on legal signoff, or offer a phased delivery (network-only first)? Need decision and comms owner.
2) Prioritization between long-context tail latency vs. quantization-driven cost wins for Dedicated capacity roadmap. Ask: shift two sprints to latency fixes?
3) Sales credit for pilot: approve $Xk credit & professional services discount to secure contract?

Risks & mitigations to surface:
- Legal delay on FinServ pilot: mitigation = offer a security-validated isolated VPC deployment with limited feature set to buy time. Owner: Maya (Legal + Solutions). ETA: 2026-03-11 for contract addendum.
- SRE capacity: on-call load increased; hiring pipeline slow. Mitigation = temporary escalation of infra contractors + reprioritize runbook automation. Owner: Liam (SRE).

Metrics to show (bring slides / one-pagers):
- Hosted API latency breakdown (p50/p95/p99) by model class, last 30 days.
- Dedicated capacity utilization and tail latency by sequence length.
- FinServ pilot compliance checklist and outstanding items.
- Cost pilot expected delta and projected savings (Redwood Optimize).

Action items (pre-meeting / items to confirm):
- Evan: bring p99 spike postmortem short summary + proposed immediate mitigation (cache warm strategies). Due: 2026-03-04 10:00am.
- Maya: confirm legal review status and prepare recommended contract language for KMS/escrow. Due: 2026-03-04 12:00pm.
- Liam: summarize SRE on-call load, open headcount status, and temporary contractor plan. Due: 2026-03-04 11:00am.
- Priya (me): draft customer-facing commit options for FinServ pilot (phased vs full) + recommended message to send if we need to delay. Due: 2026-03-04 09:30am.

Notes to self / talking points: keep the conversation outcome-oriented — want at most 2 concrete decisions (pilot timeline & Dedicated prioritization). Avoid getting stuck on pricing details; defer to follow-up with Sales and RevOps. Bring one-slide visuals: 1) latency trend heatmap, 2) pilot compliance checklist, 3) cost pilot expected impact.

Follow-up process after meeting:
- I will capture decisions and push a short exec-summary email within 2 hours. Use subject: "Exec decisions + action items — 2026-03-04".
- Assign owners in Asana and tag leads on Slack (#exec-decisions).

Open items / parking lot (to resolve after exec):
- Evaluate bumping Dedicated cluster quota for EMEA region (ask from Infra).
- Longer term: SES for on-prem deployments (pricing + operational model) — plan kickoff with Product & Sales.

Draft Slack message (for post-meeting):
"Thanks all — captured decisions from this morning's exec sync. Short summary + owners in email. Immediate next steps: Maya to finish legal language, Evan to implement cache warm plan, Liam to allocate contractors. Please check Asana tasks and confirm ETA."

End of prep notes.

-- Priya
